FEAT-6-S19.title: Consent Data Schema and Persistence Model
FEAT-6-S19.description: Define and implement MongoDB schema and Pydantic models for consent records, including tier designation (Tier 1/Tier 2), timestamping, user/session linkage, and audit fields required for HIPAA compliance.

FEAT-6-S20.title: Consent Workflow Integration with Lead and Unknown Services
FEAT-6-S20.description: Integrate consent enforcement with lead_capture and unknown_question services to ensure Tier 1 enforces de-identification and Tier 2 allows identifiable storage, aligning with existing service contracts.
